<!---
BEFORE YOU OPEN AN ISSUE:
- If you have a question about content, make sure you are looking at the raw .md files which contain the master version of the text and not in the CSV, JSON, XLSX, PDF, DOCX files which are derived from this.
- Please search the issues in case your question has been discussed before.
- Make sure you are looking at the latest edits at: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/tree/master/4.0
- When you reference requirements, please include them as a link, similarly to this:
[6.1.2](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x14-V6-Cryptography.md#v61-data-classification)

OTHER NOTES:
- Please do not open a pull request without first opening an associated issue.
- Please carry out all discussion in the associated issue only.
-->
## References

[V3.4.4](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x12-V3-Session-management.md#v34-cookie-based-session-management)

> V3.4.4 | Verify that cookie-based session tokens use "__Host-" prefix **(see references)** to provide session cookie confidentiality.

[V13.2.3](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x21-V13-API.md#v132-restful-web-service-verification-requirements)

> V13.2.3 | Verify that RESTful web services that utilize cookies are protected from Cross-Site Request Forgery via the use of at least one or more of the following: triple or double submit cookie pattern **(see [references](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Cross-Site_Request_Forgery_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html))**, CSRF nonces, or Origin request header checks.

Only 2 requirements have "see references" as part of requirement text and only one of them is provided in markdown syntax link.

I think requirement description should have clean text without any extra references.

Problem - if to use data in JSON format or want to use description text, then you need to cleanup requirement texts manually. Description text is not usable like it should be.

comments.body: I agree with avoiding links within the requirement text. I will take this as there is another issue related to triple submit cookies.

This related question can be based on my created issue there: https://github.com/OWASP/CheatSheetSeries/issues/195

Another question - V13.2.3 is a bit duplicate for V4.2.2 where there is no list of potential defense solutions. Isn't this list actually too complicated to maintain - to list all potential solutions?

[V4.2.2](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x12-V4-Access-Control.md#v42-operation-level-access-control)

> V4.2.2 Verify that the application or framework enforces a strong anti-CSRF mechanism to protect authenticated functionality, and effective anti-automation or anti-CSRF protects unauthenticated functionality.

Another related issue to V4.2.2 - #795

OK, taking your other question to #795.

Action on me to get the triple submit cookie thing resolved.

title: Cleanup verification descriptions (V3.4.4 and V13.2.3) from references
